messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "Pack is added to LN-48201 (daughter) instead of the confirmed own line LN-48210.", "verifier": {"reason": "The assistant incorrectly targeted LN-48201 (Maria Sander's line) instead of LN-48210 (Oleg Sander's line) for the roaming pack addition, despite the user's explicit confirmation for LN-48210. This violates the policy requirement to act only on lines listed under the subscriber's name and the confirmed line."}}
